title: rel0-5-2-os1.74: Sidecar 0.5.2 mods, OS 1.74 (default, recommended)
description: The Rytm firmware 0.5.2, for OS 1.74 only: drop the stock Analog-Rytm_MKII_OS1.74.syx (a Rytm on OS 1.73 needs Elektron's OS 1.74 first). The 0.5.1.1 mods plus the Rytm side of MORPH: the QUICK PERF knob's scene morph and scene edit on the Rytm's own pages (PAGE + T15 / T16 held, a turn locks the parameter, a knob press removes the lock), full effect names and further SEND FX pages for a user effect's parameters, the WAVETABLE labels (TBLB, POSB, MIX, FTYP) and table B's pool browser, and an answer to the Pi's re-hello. Pi 0.5.2 with Rytm 0.5.2 is the tested pair; the Pi 0.5.2 is built to keep working with the Rytm firmware 0.5.1.1, untested. Recovery is the stock OS file. Back up every project first. The same file elekloader builds from core-0.1-os1.74.elemod + rytm-sidecar-0.5.2-os1.74.elemod with version 1.74 (sha256 2e4ffe07...d1966). Goes with Sidecar 0.5.2 on the Pi.
